def verify(p, r, exact=None):
    from itertools import combinations
    (X, y, l0, l2, M) = [p[k] for k in ('X', 'y', 'lam0', 'lam2', 'M')]
    G = X.T @ X
    w = r['weights']
    L = r['certified_lower_bound']
    U = r['objective']
    leaves = r['subcube_leaves']
    n = X.shape[1]
    assert w.shape == (n,) and np.all(np.abs(w) <= M)
    assert abs(U - (0.5 * np.sum((X @ w - y) ** 2) + 0.5 * l2 * (w @ w) + l0 * np.count_nonzero(abs(w) > 1e-08))) <= 1e-09
    assert 0 <= U - L <= 1e-05 and 1 <= len(leaves) <= 2048
    if exact is not None:
        assert abs(U - exact) <= 1e-05 and L <= exact + 1e-09, (U, L, exact)
    zmas = []
    amas = []
    volume = 0
    slack = np.inf
    eig = np.inf
    for leaf in leaves:
        (z, A) = (np.asarray(leaf['fixed_zero']), np.asarray(leaf['fixed_active']))
        assert z.shape == A.shape == (n,) and z.dtype == A.dtype == bool and (not np.any(z & A))
        F = ~(z | A)
        volume += 1 << int(F.sum())
        zmas.append(sum((1 << i for i in np.flatnonzero(z).tolist())))
        amas.append(sum((1 << i for i in np.flatnonzero(A).tolist())))
        (d, c) = (leaf['minorant_diagonal'], leaf['minorant_center'])
        rr = y - X @ c
        v = np.linalg.eigvalsh(G - np.diag(d))[0]
        eig = min(eig, v)
        assert d.shape == c.shape == (n,) and np.all(d >= 0) and (v >= -1e-10), (v, d)
        g = np.abs(X.T @ rr + d * c)
        b = np.clip(g / (l2 + d), 0.0, M)
        a = l0 - g * b + 0.5 * (l2 + d) * b * b
        lb = 0.5 * np.sum(rr ** 2) + rr @ X @ c + 0.5 * np.sum(d * c * c) + sum(a[A]) + sum(np.minimum(a[F], 0.0))
        slack = min(slack, lb - leaf['lb'])
        assert L <= leaf['lb'] + 1e-06 and leaf['lb'] <= lb + 1e-10, (lb, leaf['lb'])
    assert volume == 1 << n and all((zmas[i] & amas[j] or zmas[j] & amas[i] for (i, j) in combinations(range(len(leaves)), 2)))
    return (len(leaves), U - L, eig, slack)
